sentences.text: No; for an existing floating-rate term loan sanctioned before 31 December 2025 to an individual for a purpose other than business, a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges.
The same result applies here because the case is a floating-rate, non-business term loan to an individual sanctioned in 2023.
The earlier 2014 floating-rate term-loan circular was superseded and is no longer in force.
The question does not need the later 2026 pre-payment-charge provisions, because they apply to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, while this loan was sanctioned in 2023.
